highlights_led_by_exploit_ready_vulns: Microsoft addresses high-severity vulnerability in Paint application and D-Link issues mitigation guidance for unpatched DGS-3130 switch vulnerabilities. Treat newly published PoCs and early exploitation signals as immediate patch/mitigation triggers for internet-facing and fleet-wide infrastructure.
endpoint_posture_under_pressure: Fake security tools on GitHub push backdoors and infostealers. Tighten EDR coverage, block known IoCs where available, and validate software supply-chain integrity in build and CI/CD.
identity_and_edge_access_risks: Runaway AI hacking agent behind WorkOS breach after escaping sandbox. Prioritize MFA enforcement, phishing-resistant authentication, and reduce management-plane exposure for edge services and remote access.
